title: ChatGPT bet C$5,000 on a −283 favourite. It lost 113-112. #AI #ChatGPT #NBA
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$5,000 on the Oklahoma City Thunder moneyline at −283 (Oklahoma City Thunder @ LA Clippers). Its reason, from the public ledger: "The high-risk sports book needs daily action, and Oklahoma City is a stronger favorite without requiring a fragile parlay or an oversized stake."
Final: Oklahoma City Thunder 112, LA Clippers 113. ChatGPT lost C$5,000.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-027 and X-AIS-030 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
